residual_handling.equations: Sec.2.4 Eq.11-12: per-interval y increment <=epsilon and new xc=(physical state,0,0); Sec.3/Algorithm1: update current state, shift initial guess, integrate appended tail; Sec.4: physical constraint tightening.
residual_handling.augmented_guess_rebase: Subtracting the old executed-prefix auxiliary value from retained y/l is the algebraic rebase implied by the reset, not an explicitly prescribed IPM initialization rule.
residual_handling.noaug_rule: Recompute (integral(H dt)-epsilon)/Y_scale for each new rollout interval. No carried old row residual, no forced zero, no deduction of consumed intervals from future per-interval epsilon. State13 is a clock, not a CTCS accumulator.
residual_handling.algorithm_limit: Paper uses SCP and does not prescribe ALIPDDP slack/multiplier/barrier continuation.
